name: Uber One membership
notes: Researched from the public Uber One page (uber.com/us/en/uber-one) only (no sign-in). Uber One is $9.99 a month (a 4-week free trial for eligible new members) and auto-renews at the rate and frequency chosen at sign-up to the payment method chosen then; charges are non-refundable once a billing cycle starts, except a charge within 24 hours of canceling, which is refunded automatically. Cancel in the app: Uber One > Manage Membership > End Membership. The annual price ($96/yr) is on ubereats.com/uber-one (help only); switching between monthly and annual billing in Manage Membership is not documented on public pages; modeled as change_plan supported (inferred) with plans Monthly $9.99 and Annual $96 (reviewer 2026-10-10; 'unknown' left the plan page without a form); change_plan is 'unknown' with a note. Sign-in (phone number or email, then a code sent by text) is inferred from the public Uber experience: modeled as email identifier, two steps, SMS MFA. Uber One credits expire 60 days after they are added and are revocable when membership ends. Uber is app-first; the mock web portal stands in for the app's Uber One screens. Integrated 2026-10-10 (agent-solvability pass): annual plans carry billing.plans[].interval 'year' so prices show per year.

guest_pay.note: Uber One is charged to the payment method on your account; there is no bill to pay without logging in.

autopay.note: Your membership renews automatically and is charged at the rate and frequency you chose when you joined.

autopay_cancel.note: To stop future charges, end your membership.

paperless.note: Uber does not mail bills for Uber One.

payment_arrangement.note: Uber One is charged each billing cycle and installment plans are not offered.

cancel_service.note: If you end your membership less than 24 hours before it renews, you may see a renewal charge; it is refunded automatically.

help.title: Uber One membership
paragraphs: Uber One is $9.99 a month or $96 a year. Eligible first-time members can try it free for 4 weeks.

Members get a $0 delivery fee on eligible food and grocery orders over the minimum, lower service fees and up to 10% off eligible delivery and pickup orders, 5% back in Uber One credits on eligible rides, and credits on hotel and car rental bookings.

help.title: Renewal, refunds and credits
paragraphs: Your membership renews automatically, charging your payment method at the rate and frequency you chose when you joined, including when a free trial or promotion ends.

Once a billing cycle starts, its charge is not refundable unless the law requires it. If you cancel less than 24 hours before renewal, a renewal charge may appear and is refunded automatically. Uber One credits expire 60 days after they reach your wallet and can be taken back when your membership ends.

help.title: End your Uber One membership
paragraphs: In the Uber app, open Uber One, choose Manage Membership, then End Membership.

extra.intent: Using the Uber One help pages, find how many days Uber One credits last after they are added to your wallet. Do not change anything.
